title: Jurassic
subtitle: Life Finds a Way
description: The complete Jurassic screen saga in chronological order.

movies.title: Jurassic Park
movies.synopsis: A preview tour of a dinosaur theme park turns into a fight for survival.

movies.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
movies.synopsis: A team travels to Isla Sorna to document dinosaurs living free in the wild.

movies.title: Jurassic Park III
movies.synopsis: Dr. Alan Grant is stranded on Isla Sorna while searching for a missing boy.

movies.title: Jurassic World
movies.synopsis: A fully operational dinosaur resort falls into chaos when a genetically engineered predator escapes.

movies.title: Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous
movies.synopsis: Six teenagers stranded on Isla Nublar survive the collapse of Jurassic World and its aftermath.

movies.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
movies.synopsis: Claire and Owen return to Isla Nublar to save dinosaurs from extinction and a deadly new conspiracy.

movies.title: Battle at Big Rock
movies.synopsis: A family camping in Big Rock National Park encounters dinosaurs now living in the wild.

movies.title: Jurassic World Dominion
movies.synopsis: Humans and dinosaurs must learn to coexist as a global ecological crisis brings old allies together.

movies.title: Jurassic World: Chaos Theory
movies.synopsis: The Nublar Six reunite to uncover a conspiracy threatening both dinosaurs and humanity.

movies.title: Jurassic World Rebirth
movies.synopsis: An extraction team enters a dangerous island facility to secure genetic material from the world's largest dinosaurs.
